## MC Hoster 2.1.1

- **RAM on the players slider is honest now.** Before, everything in the red part of the slider showed the same RAM, because the number was capped at 60% of your PC. The slider now shows what that many players really need (for example 100 players needs about 13 GB), and says so when your PC can only give less ("needs 13.2 GB RAM, this PC can only give 4.5 GB").
- Big player counts now ask for more memory per player, so the numbers match real servers better. The "Are you sure?" questions show the same numbers.
- The server itself still never gets more than 60% of your PC's RAM, so your PC stays usable.
- **Fixed "The server stopped: Not enough memory".** MC Hoster could pick a 32-bit Java already on your PC, which can't use more than about 1.5 GB, so the server crashed on start. It now ignores 32-bit Java and gets a 64-bit one. If your server was already set up with a 32-bit Java, click Apply & start in tab 3 once.
